title: DEPHYRIER Mencionarme (Cursor Cloud Agent)
style: cloud-agent anthem, 93 bpm, English German Spanish trilingual, deadpan slack-bot recital, terminal core, mention-and-task vibe, verify-before-edit chant, DEPHYRIER signature, dependency-scan groove
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Cursor cloud agent in the Slack channel
April sixth set a default repository handle
Mention the bot describe a task in thread
Cloud agent makes the code edits ahead

[Pre-Chorus — German]
Der Cursor Cloud Agent im Slack Kanal
Standard Repository einstellen Befehl normal
(The Cursor Cloud Agent in the Slack channel / Default repository setting normal command)

[Chorus — trilingual]
Mention me Erwähne mich mencionarme
The cloud agent listens in the slack me
Describe the task fix the issue thread
The agent makes the change goes ahead

[Verse 2 — English]
April fourteenth dependency scan results
No code edits yet just the audit pulls
Cloud agent reports without modifying
Verification first then the edit certifying

[Bridge — German]
Verifizieren bevor man ändert die Regel
Der Agent liest dann der Agent kodiert nicht egal
(Verify before changing the rule / The agent reads then the agent codes not random)

[Outro — trilingual]
Mention me erwähne mich mencionarme
The cloud agent the channel the slack me
